name: theme-service
description: Create WCAG 2.2 AA compliant dark/light themes and install them into any repo, new or legacy. A theme that fails contrast is never written. Includes the Claude Code skill (and AGENTS.md) for creating, applying, and updating themes. Version is tracked in the VERSION file.

scripts.install-all: node install/install.mjs --builtins true && npm run build-themes
scripts.//release: Bump VERSION + prepend CHANGELOG.md + tag vX.Y.Z. Commit feature work FIRST — it refuses on a dirty tree. Usage: npm run release <patch|minor|major> -- --note "what changed"   (--note is required; the -- is what passes it through npm. Flags: --allow-dirty, --yes)
scripts.//dev:overview-site: LOCAL DEV of this repo's informational GitHub Pages site (docs/overview.html + themes/preview.html) ONLY. Not needed to install or use the theme service.
